title: UI: Publish Settings dialog
description: Add a Publish Settings dialog to the authoring UI. Flash 8 had File > Publish Settings. The dialog should allow: SWF version selector (Flash 8 = SWF v8), stage dimensions, background color picker, frame rate. Uses withProperties() from @flash/core engine. Accessible via keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Shift+F12 and File menu. Modal overlay pattern consistent with other dialogs in the app.
